title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: No new US trading session — Saturday/Sunday, and Monday Sept 7 is a Labor Day market holiday, so Friday's close (Dow 53,414, S&P 500 7,718.60, Nasdaq 26,507, all down on hot jobs data) remains the latest print; next session opens Tuesday.
Macro/Policy: No fresh catalysts over the weekend to add to Friday's story — Fed rate-hike odds for this month still sit near 58-59% after the blowout August payrolls report (+162K vs +53K expected).
Macro/Policy: Looking ahead — the next FOMC meeting is Sept 15-16, with the August CPI report due next week as the key input before that decision.
Companies: No material weekend developments beyond Friday's items already reported (VW job-cut plan, Tesla Cybercab launch scrutiny, Flex/EPC Power deal, Moonshot AI's $50B valuation).
